scripts.q: Why hire Khalil as an AI engineer? Production LLM agents and RAG systems with real users

hits.title: The AI Company: 3 production AI agents

scripts.answer: Khalil co-founded The AI Company and shipped three production AI agents (accounting RAG, CV screening, HR) used by 500+ people [1]; works with LangChain, LlamaIndex, LLaMA fine-tuning with LoRA, RAG and vector databases [2]; and built an ML vendor-recommendation system at EY that informed a $500K AI platform investment [3].

scripts.q: Has Khalil deployed LLM and RAG systems to production for real users?

hits.title: The AI Company: 3 production AI agents

scripts.answer: Khalil built and deployed a LLaMA RAG chatbot on AWS that still serves 1,000+ users [1]; co-founded The AI Company and shipped three production AI agents (accounting RAG, CV screening, HR) used by 500+ people [2]; and works with LangChain, LlamaIndex, LLaMA fine-tuning with LoRA, RAG and vector databases [3].

scripts.q: Research publications: accepted IEEE conference papers

hits.title: Education: Erasmus Mundus M.Sc. · AUC B.Sc.

scripts.answer: Khalil published an IEEE ICGHIT paper on sustainable LLM training and inference in orbit [1]; is first author of an IEEE QCNC paper that cut WiFi localisation features by 90.4% with QUBO optimisation on D-Wave [2]; and is doing an Erasmus Mundus M.Sc. in advanced ML and optimisation in Genova and Compiègne [3].

scripts.q: Can Khalil work remotely? Location, time zone and availability
scripts.answer: Khalil is based in Genova, Italy (CET), open to fully remote work and available immediately [1]; built and deployed a LLaMA RAG chatbot on AWS that still serves 1,000+ users [2]; and is first author of an IEEE QCNC paper that cut WiFi localisation features by 90.4% with QUBO optimisation on D-Wave [3].
